title: Multi-Class Support Vector Machine with Differential Privacy

split.decision: One archived paper partition is privately selected and fixed for all ten independent fits to prevent cross-run leakage. Validation: stratified 20% of the remaining training partition, random_state=20261029; train 998, val 250. Ten independently seeded fits per BENCH_SEED; baseline uses train only. Original row IDs, sorted; no scaling. Hidden selection details are operator-only.

allowed_changes: Private mechanism, privacy accountant representation supported by trusted formulas, solver, optimizer, learning schedule, iterations and equivalent reparameterization may change.
Auxiliary numerical surrogates must solve the same SVM objective; all private data access, sensitivity, noise and composition require truthful accounting.
When retaining the supplied Adam/Opacus pipeline, changing only lr=0.005, epochs=30, batch_size=128 or max_grad_norm=1 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve private optimization of the selected affine multiclass SVM on ISOLET under epsilon<=1 and delta=1e-5, retaining its margin objective and ten independent-run accuracy metric.

The raw-feature affine map R^617 to R^26, class argmax rule and selected Regularized_loss (multiclass hinge plus .001/1560 times the ordered pairwise squared weight-distance sum) are the research object.

Only the supplied training partition fits weights; fixed validation may guide selection. The ten independent fits, original input/label space, per-run DP guarantee, mean accuracy and acceptance rule remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace the affine SVM with nonlinear features, neural classification, an ensemble prediction, cross-entropy target or another regularized objective.
No merging validation into the fitted training population, hidden examples/labels, prediction-time fitting, fabricated ledgers or self-reported final epsilon.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

evidence.finding: M3-SVM has the margin objective; a same-architecture cross-entropy Linear model is a distinct comparator.
Selected task explicitly requires an affine 617-to-26 DP classifier trained only on the training split.
Fixes released hinge-plus-pairwise-weight objective and its normalization; Adam/Opacus are numerical/private mechanisms.
Restored executable affine certificate reconstruction while retaining flexible trusted mechanism ledger.

validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
